summary_i18n.en: The preliminaries of the Warsong Festival were approaching, but Alsa was unexpectedly injured. Hopefully, she'll recover soon.
summary_i18n.jp: 戦歌祭の初戦を控えているアルサは、予期せぬ怪我を負ってしまった。早く治るといいのだが。
